Hi Elena —

Thanks for the remittance and receipt, and for the clear breakdown. We can do either approach but our standard accounting workflow is to apply the VAT portion directly to the invoices unless you instruct us to issue a separate credit memo. Applying proportionally keeps invoice aging aligned for both parties.

Before I proceed, two quick confirmation items:
- Can you confirm the exact VATable amounts to split between 7891 / 7892 (net vs VAT)? If you only have totals, we can prorate by invoice totals.
- Confirm whether GreenLeaf requires separate VAT documentation (e.g., transfer reason code on our credit note) for your internal VAT reclaim.

If I don't hear otherwise by EOD tomorrow we'll prorate the VAT across 7891 and 7892 and update your statement. Once done I'll upload the updated Statement of Account and issue ledger notes.

I'll loop in Marcus to flag this against the DL-8341 opportunity in case any billing dispute needs commercial review. Laura — FYI on the allocation; happy to escalate if GreenLeaf prefers a credit memo.

Best,
